items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that sending a smooth projective scheme to itself and a morphism to the class of its graph defines a contravariant functor to the category of correspondences (statement lines 609-614). The proof (proof lines 615-642) reduces functoriality to an equality of intersection products and identifies the graph of a composite with the pushforward of the intersection of the two graphs. H2: a complete short argument in two steps.
